title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
summary: Hold: the briefing attributes the rollout schedule to a notice updated on 3 November, but the supplied Microsoft notice was updated on 19 November. The migration, licensing and documented controls are supported; a shortened transcription path and checklist steps without matching table rows also need correction.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-11-19T00:53:06.
Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: MeetingAI controls the availability of Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap and other meeting AI features.
claims.quote: MeetingAI - controls whether Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap, and other AI features are available in meetings.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; controls[1].note
claims.claim: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.claim: The current Copilot policy combines AI availability with whether a saved transcript is required, and the replacement separates them.
claims.quote: Today, the Copilot policy combines whether AI is available in a meeting with whether a saved transcript is required. After this update, these behaviors are represented by two separate settings:

claims.claim: The new model permits administrators to enforce Copilot off.
claims.quote: including the ability to enforce Copilot off.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: The replacement controls arrive without administrator action, so the change's default state is on.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations.

claims.claim: Microsoft performs a one-time mapping from existing Copilot values to the two new policy values.
claims.quote: Microsoft will perform a one-time update mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values

claims.where: What's changing; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The one-time mapping preserves the current effective behaviour.
claims.quote: preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators do not need to recreate their policies.
claims.quote: Administrators do not need to recreate their policies.

claims.claim: Existing policies receive mapped values rather than being reset to the parameter defaults.
claims.quote: mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values, preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride as the MeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote:
### -MeetingAI
Default value: | EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledNoOverride as the TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote:
### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI

claims.claim: The reference warns that the replacement parameters have no effect because the feature is not fully released.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI:

claims.claim: Allow AI in meetings offers On, Off but organisers can change, and Off and organisers cannot change.
claims.quote: Allow AI in meetings: On / Off, but organizers can change / Off, and organizers cannot change

claims.claim: The Transcription policy remains and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.
claims.quote: The Transcription policy remains available and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI replaces the Allow Copilot and Facilitator meeting option.
claims.quote: Who can manage AI - replaces the existing Allow Copilot and Facilitator option

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; rationale: impact

claims.quote: determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.

claims.quote: If an admin turns Meeting AI off, this option is set to No one.

claims.claim: Who can use AI is a meeting option allowing organisers to narrow which participants use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.claim: Start Transcription with AI lets organisers choose whether transcription starts with AI.

claims.quote: Intelligent Recap controls - lets organizers decide whether an Intelligent Recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including for meetings where a transcript is not created.

claims.claim: The transcription UI path ends at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription <$true|$false> allows or prohibits transcription.
claims.quote:
### -AllowTranscription
Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an admin UI for the AllowIntelligentRecap availability control.
claims.quote: Searched: 'AllowIntelligentRecap Teams admin center disable toggle'. Opened intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; availability is documented through PowerShell, and the documented UI controls expiration instead.

To turn off intelligent recap ... set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.

claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.quote:
### -AllowIntelligentRecap
This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. Controls whether Intelligent Recap is allowed for the user's meetings.

claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default.
